task.title: Bookmark learning resources
task.shortdesc: Bookmark Hybrid Cloud Console learning resources that you want to refer to later to help you find them easily.

step.cmd: If necessary, add the Bookmarked learning resources widget to the Hybrid Cloud Console home page. See Customize your Hybrid Cloud Console home page for information about adding widgets.
Use one of the following methods to find a learning resource:

ul.li: Click the Help button to open the help panel, then select the Learn tab to display a full list of learning resources.
Open the All learning resources page directly.
Click Learning Resources in the left menu of any service page.

step.cmd: Click the bookmark icon on the resource that you want to bookmark. Bookmarked resources are listed in the Bookmarked learning resources widget on the home page and on each Learning Resources page.
